# DropSpace v0.3.0-preview.23 — Native Island UI refactor

<!-- update-summary: Preview.23 completes the single-island compact and expanded UI refactor with media-aware layout, DWM-owned framing, split settings surfaces, and schema-13 persistence while preserving Smart Drag/OLE and Windows system-volume ownership. -->

Preview.23 is the next test release defined by the Preview.23 UI/UX refactor plan. It carries forward the x64 Windows build 20348 boundary and Preview.22 activity contracts, then makes the Dynamic Island experience coherent as one native HWND with a bounded Compact media presentation and a three-page Expanded surface.

## Shipped changes

- Adds a pure compact-media layout contract: artwork, lyric/title fallback, optional secondary lyric, spectrum geometry, fixed-height rendering, and dynamic width clamped to the supported island range.
- Connects Compact media presentation to the existing activity runtime, including real playback metadata/timeline, bounded spectrum frames, paused/no-session idle hiding, configurable 0.5–30 second hide delay, and settings-driven refresh notifications.
- Adds one non-wrapping Expanded pager in Files → Music → Widgets order. Files shows recent staged items and the empty Open DropSpace state; Music shows cover/metadata/lyrics/spectrum/progress and playback controls; Widgets shows the normalized 6×3 Clock/Calendar/Resource/Settings grid and compact slots.
- Adds bounded page geometry and compositor-backed opacity/offset transitions while retaining one island window and the existing OLE/direct-drop business path.
- Removes the XAML outer stroke and moves transient island outer appearance to a capability-gated DWM backdrop/frame controller with a transparent inner XAML surface and rounded clip.
- Promotes Music and the planned Settings category surfaces in the Main window, including Widget layout editing and System Activities controls. Plugin, custom-font, native volume-flyout replacement, and Liquid Glass controls remain outside the product boundary.
- Advances settings schema 12 to 13 while preserving nested settings and adds regression tests for compact bounds, pager defaults/no-wrap, idle hiding, and Widget layout persistence. English and Simplified Chinese resources remain synchronized.

## Verification

- Source-level XML/resource parity, C# policy tests, migration fixtures, and repository diff checks are part of the change set.
- The authoritative Windows CI and Release workflows remain the gates for WinUI compilation, Windows App SDK/WinRT projections, portable smoke, package/installer generation, release metadata, and public asset verification.
- The release publishes exactly five validated Preview assets: `DropSpaceSetup.exe`, `DropSpace.exe`, `DropSpace-x64.msix`, `SHA256SUMS.txt`, and `update-manifest.json`.

## Conditional target verification

Real Windows 11 media-player/SMTC behavior, notification permission states, endpoint and process-loopback audio, mixed-DPI geometry, Explorer/OLE/provider behavior, accessibility, animation feel, and long-run resource stability remain **CONDITIONAL** until recorded on target Windows hosts. Hosted CI does not substitute for those physical rows.

Preview.22's tag, release, assets, and history remain untouched.
